title: Ember and Salt
author: Isandro Lockridge
blurb: Odile Eriksen, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
